event.text: You can manage this yourself for now: sucking on lozenges, drinking plenty of fluids and gargling may ease throat discomfort, and over-the-counter pain relievers can help if you follow the label. Sore throats often come from colds or viruses. If you develop trouble breathing, drooling or a lot of trouble swallowing, get emergency care right away; if the sore throat lasts more than a couple of days, you have fever, or you feel very unwell, arrange clinician review (Counsel messaging or another same-day option if that isn't available).
